All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class FixedComponentDTO extends ShipConstructionEventDTO
Represents a data transfer data object that holds information about a component that has been removed to fix a ship * Annotations from the Jackson library are used for JSON serialization and deserialization, * ensuring that only non-null values are included in the JSON output.
